messages:
ajay_s: Hey team — vendor sent a partial allocation for the UK demo racks. They can deliver 4/8 A100s by Wed EOD, remaining 4 on 2024-05-15. Need quota bump + serials for onprem onboarding. Anyone on procurement path?

maria_p: Thanks Ajay. Can you paste the vendor allocation email? I'll ping vendor ops.

ajay_s: pasted snippet:
```
Vendor: partial shipment 4 A100s (serials attached) ETA 2024-05-10, remainder 2024-05-15. Invoice pending.
```

samir_k: Adding procurement loop — @procurement-bot what's the invoice ETA and do we need PO? :eyes: 

procurement-bot: Invoice expected by 2024-05-09. Need PO if > $50k. Send vendor contact.

chen_l: For quota, do we need cloud GPU quota increase or just physical acceptance? If we need cloud quota for staging, run `gcloud compute regions describe europe-west2 --project=redwood-infer` to check.

ajay_s: We need both — staging in GCP and rack serials for onprem image signing. Samir, can you open a quick TF PR to reserve the racks?

samir_k: On it, will post PR link in ~30m. Quick heads up: if vendor slips, fallback is borrowing 2 racks from demo pool (can confirm with @maria_p).

maria_p: I can approve demo borrow for up to 72h. Ping me with exact rack IDs.

chen_l: Also putting this on nightly canary — ops-runbook-bot, please schedule smoke test for 2024-05-11 03:00 UTC.

ops-runbook-bot: Canary scheduled 2024-05-11 03:00 UTC. Notified oncall.

ajay_s: Thanks. last ask — need serials exposed to onboarding team. @maria_p can you confirm vendor will share full serial list and firmware revs?

maria_p: Vendor confirmed they'll share serials + firmware matrix by EOD tomorrow. I'll cc onboarding. :thumbsup: 

samir_k: PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/terraform/pull/482 — reserves racks if we get full allocation. Please review when you can.

chen_l: Quick quota check command I ran returned 60 available GPUs in eu-west2. If anyone needs me to request increase, say the count.

ajay_s: Great, wrapping — leaving vendor point to Maria, TF PR to Samir, canary scheduled. Thanks all. :rocket:
